sections.Profile:
"Sittin' Pretty," released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in November 1958, is a single-player, electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker. The playfield features two flippers, four pop bumpers, two slingshots, two standup targets, and a central roto-target.
